description: This source file implements various merge operations for a version control system, including non-recursive and recursive merges, handling commit objects and their trees, and interfacing with repository locking mechanisms.

classes.name: struct merge_result
classes.description: Holds the result status and data from a merge operation.

classes.name: struct lock_file
classes.description: Represents a lock on the repository index during merge operations.

classes.name: struct commit
classes.description: Represents a commit object in the repository.

classes.name: struct tree
classes.description: Represents a tree object in the repository.

classes.name: struct object
classes.description: Generic object in version control, can be a commit, tree, or tag.

classes.name: struct object_id
classes.description: Identifier for objects, typically a hash.

classes.name: struct commit_list
classes.description: Linked list of commit objects used during merge base processing.

classes.name: struct merge_options
classes.description: Configuration options for performing merge operations.

methods.name: int unclean(struct merge_options * opt,struct tree * head)
methods.description: Checks repository state to see if there are uncommitted changes that would be overwritten by merge.

methods.name: int merge_ort_nonrecursive(struct merge_options * opt,struct tree * head,struct tree * merge,struct tree * merge_base)
methods.description: Performs a non-recursive merge of two trees.

methods.name: int merge_ort_recursive(struct merge_options * opt,struct commit * side1,struct commit * side2,const struct commit_list * merge_bases,struct commit ** result)
methods.description: Performs a recursive merge between two commits, combining their histories.

methods.name: struct:commit * get_ref(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * oid,const char * name)
methods.description: Fetches a commit object reference, potentially interpreting tags as virtual commits.

methods.name: int merge_ort_generic(struct merge_options * opt,const struct object_id * head,const struct object_id * merge,int num_merge_bases,const struct object_id * merge_bases,struct commit ** result)
methods.description: Generic merge function that handles resolving merges given commit identifiers and optional merge bases.
